main_text.l: In sorte Beniamin nihil occurrit magnopere
notatu dignum, nisi quod exigua tribus aliis o-
rdine præfertur. Fateor quidem pro hominum
paucitate redacta fuisse in angustos limites,quia
tantum viginti sex vrbes obtinuit: fuit tamen id
per se honorificum, ante alias tribus nobiliores
hæreditatem accipere. Adde quòd hoc modo
coniuncti ac finitimi fuerunt reliquis filiis Ioseph,
runt enim medii inter Ephraim &Manasse ab v-
na parte,& inter tribum Iuda,ab altera. Fuit etiā
eximius honor,quod inter alias vrbes,Ierusalem illis

page.notes: Verse numbers 24–28 are set in large type as printed. The running head and page number are at the top; the catchword "illis" is at the lower right. Some words in the commentary are slightly blurred (e.g. "Iebusi", "Mispeh") and may need checking against the scan.
